# goruntime

```go
import "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/pkg/v1/observe/metrics/goruntime"
```

Package goruntime publishes the Go runtime's instruments on a metrics meter (#868): RuntimeInstruments registers them with the OpenTelemetry Go runtime conventions' names, kinds and units. It stands apart from metrics because it reads runtime/metrics, which a program pays for by importing it: only a program that registers the runtime's instruments imports this package.

<a name="RuntimeInstruments"></a>
## func [RuntimeInstruments](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/pkg/v1/observe/metrics/goruntime/gen_facade.go>)

```go
func RuntimeInstruments(meter coremetrics.AsyncMeter, cfg RuntimeConfig)
```

RuntimeInstruments registers the Go runtime's instruments on meter with the OpenTelemetry Go runtime conventions' names, kinds and units (go.memory.used, go.goroutine.count, …, and on an AsyncHistogramMeter the histograms go.schedule.duration and go.gc.duration), read at Collect from one runtime/metrics.Read. Underscore names them for a Prometheus meter.
